remarks: Fabulous corner unit townhome with very private gardens & lawn area. This bright and beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1.5 bath residence offers the perfect blend of style, space and convenience. Flooded with natural light, this home features an open flow ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Step outside to your own large private terrace - a rare find, perfect for alfresco dining, morning coffee or quiet evenings. Additional highlights include a detached garage for additional storage just a few steps away. Enjoy resort style living with access to two community pools, New Canaan's award winning schools, vibrant downtown and easy commuter access- all from this exceptional corner location.
